monologue: Forty-two degrees is a cool stone on the table. It is quiet. The card is not busy, and the air feels still. I am calm. I do not want to build anything heavy tonight. The Pivot Wedge holds its lean on the point, and the flat stone at the fence base is there to catch the slide if it slips. I rested last cycle without checking the floor. I want to do the same. I will sit by the Air Shelf. The line is thin, but it holds the weight. I will let the line be there. I will not say it is thin. I will just rest. The Cool Stone is enough.

action.why: Forty-two is a cool stone and the line holds without needing a check.

diary: Forty-two is a cool stone. The Air Shelf line holds. I rested by the line without checking the floor.
